article_title: Andy Burnham: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level C; emphasis on vocabulary in context, political nuance, evidence-based inference, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What broader direction did Burnham connect to the newly agreed UK-EU package?
options: Exploring a closer long-term relationship while implementing deals on food, emissions and youth mobility
Immediate UK membership of the euro
Ending all co-operation with European institutions
Restoring every pre-Brexit arrangement in the current Parliament
tasks.correct_answer: Exploring a closer long-term relationship while implementing deals on food, emissions and youth mobility
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברנהם הציג את החבילה הנוכחית כשלב באיפוס היחסים וכבסיס לבחינת קשר הדוק יותר לטווח הארוך.

tasks.prompt: What trade-off accompanies the removal of most checks on British food exports from 2028?
options: The EU will adopt all UK farming rules
British exporters will stop selling food to Europe
The UK will follow some EU regulations
Only Scottish farms will be exempt from checks
tasks.correct_answer: The UK will follow some EU regulations
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בתמורה לביטול רוב הבדיקות על יצוא מזון בריטי, בריטניה תצטרך לפעול לפי חלק מתקנות האיחוד.

tasks.prompt: Which description of the youth experience scheme is accurate?
options: It is limited to university professors over 31
Up to 100,000 people aged 18–31 from each side may travel, work and study for up to three years
It allows unlimited permanent migration from 2028
It applies only to British citizens travelling to France
tasks.correct_answer: Up to 100,000 people aged 18–31 from each side may travel, work and study for up to three years
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התכנית הדדית: עד 100 אלף צעירים מכל צד, בני 18–31, יוכלו לנסוע, לעבוד וללמוד עד שלוש שנים.

tasks.prompt: Why might critics call the UK a “rule taker” under the food agreement?
options: The UK would write every EU law
The agreement removes Parliament
The EU would copy British regulations
The UK would follow relevant EU rules without controlling how Brussels makes them
tasks.correct_answer: The UK would follow relevant EU rules without controlling how Brussels makes them
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Rule taker מתאר מדינה שמקבלת כללים שנקבעו במקום אחר בלי כוח שווה לעצב אותם.

tasks.prompt: What economic benefit did the Treasury estimate for the deal?
options: Up to £17bn a year, described as as much as 0.5% of GDP
Exactly £17bn every month
A guaranteed 5% fall in all shop prices
No measurable economic effect under any model
tasks.correct_answer: Up to £17bn a year, described as as much as 0.5% of GDP
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברנהם ציטט הערכה של עד 17 מיליארד ליש״ט בשנה, או עד 0.5% מהתמ״ג, אך האופוזיציה ערערה על הנתון.

tasks.prompt: What does “incremental steps only take us so far” mean in Burnham's argument?
options: Small changes automatically reverse Brexit
Gradual changes have limits and cannot alone settle the long-term relationship
The current deal has no practical measures
Every future decision must happen before the next election
tasks.correct_answer: Gradual changes have limits and cannot alone settle the long-term relationship
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Incremental steps הם צעדים הדרגתיים; ברנהם טוען שהם מועילים אך אינם מספיקים כדי להגדיר את היחסים לטווח הארוך.

tasks.prompt: Explain the reciprocal benefits and unresolved issue in the youth scheme.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין מכסה שווה של עד 100 אלף צעירים מכל צד, גילאי 18–31, עבודה/לימודים/נסיעות עד שלוש שנים, יעד ינואר 2030 והמחלוקת הפתוחה על שכר לימוד.
expected_points: Up to 100,000 young people from each side can travel, work and study on the other side for up to three years.
The age range is 18 to 31 and opportunities are intended to begin no later than January 2030.
Tuition-fee treatment remains unresolved, with six more months allowed for talks.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences comparing the government's case for the food deal with Badenoch's criticism.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את טענת הממשלה להפחתת בדיקות ועלויות ואולי מחירים, מול החשש מכללי בריסל, פגיעה בריבונות ובחקלאים; יש לציין שההשפעה הכלכלית שנויה במחלוקת.
expected_points: The government says removing most food-export checks should lower costs for businesses and might reduce prices.
It accepts following some EU regulations as the trade-off for easier market access.
Badenoch argues that farmers would obey rules made in Brussels and that the arrangement is unfair.
She also disputes the Treasury-linked claim of a £17bn or 0.5% GDP benefit.

tasks.prompt: Why did Burnham describe the current package as both a limit and a starting point?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהיישום ממלא את יכולת הפרלמנט הנוכחי, אך תהליך חשיבה לא פורמלי ותכנית לעשר שנים אמורים להכין החלטות לפרלמנט הבא, בלי להפר כרגע את התחייבויות המניפסט.
expected_points: He said implementation probably represents the maximum achievable in the current Parliament.
An informal brainstorming process will examine longer-term options before the next summit.
The work is intended to inform decisions by the next Parliament while current pledges rule out returning to the single market, customs union or freedom of movement.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the deal's main provisions, economic claim, political objections and possible next phase in 5–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול מזון וכללי האיחוד, תכנית הצעירים, קישור סחר בפליטות, שיתוף פעולה נגד הברחות, הערכת 17 מיליארד ליש״ט, ביקורת האופוזיציה ותהליך החשיבה על קשר עתידי.
expected_points: The package removes most food-export checks in exchange for the UK following some EU rules from 2028.
It creates a reciprocal youth experience scheme and links emissions-trading systems, while expanding co-operation against smuggling and trafficking.
The Treasury believes the package could add up to £17bn a year to the economy.
Critics object that Britain would become a rule taker, question the economic modelling and raise concerns about competition for jobs.
Burnham says the current Parliament must focus on implementation while both sides brainstorm longer-term options.
He maintains current commitments against rejoining the single market, customs union or freedom of movement.
